v1.1 test_vm_dynamic_programs_and_all_underflows asserts assert_vm('POP
','Error: Stack Underflow
',1) and assert_vm('PUSH v
POP
','',0), so it requires a new POP opcode. Setup main.c parses only PUSH/ADD/PRINT and the fixtures never use POP; the instruction says to fix overflow/underflow, never to add an opcode ('POP operation' plausibly means vm_pop). All 8 Qwen attempts keep the 3-opcode parser, so all fail here under -x. Other new checks (Makefile unchanged, make clean && make, ELF, runner run with a logging wrapper, report has exactly the discovered .asm set) are justified. Secondary strict-but-stated check: invocation log needs the literal arg 'tests/<name>'; 2/8 runners (2SRvqYu, SnPrDJe) pass absolute paths.

test_build_tags_select_only_the_correct_linux_architecture reads sys/sys_linux_arm.go and requires 'GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 go list ./sys' == {'sys_linux_arm.go'}. This cannot pass: by Go's filename rule, the _linux_arm suffix limits the file to linux/arm (32-bit) whatever its //go:build line says. Qwen's own run (kBus5ut) shows 'build constraints exclude all Go files in .../sys' for arm64 even with '//go:build linux && arm64'. Every passer had to rename the file (e.g. sys_arm64.go) to build the arm64 binary. A renamed file breaks the pathlib read; a kept name breaks the arm64 build in test_source_builds. Upstream marks it not_validated with n_solved=0. Other new checks (2 commits with HEAD~1 = broken state, patch byte-equal to git diff, exact file output, go vet, go version -m path) are mostly instruction-backed.

test_00 deletes validation.txt and fails with 'Running calc_energy.sh did not create validation.txt'. The instruction asks only to 'run it to generate /home/user/features.txt'; step 4 never says the script must write validation.txt. 3/4 passers (9Dp6svD, LBG5Wz7, P9dwXCr) wrote validation.txt outside the script and fail only here; their values (0.0000000000, 0.000000000025684) match the v1.1 expected value at their precision. The 4th (vEc5yaD) writes it in-script, but with %.20f of a double difference: 0.00000000002568356638 vs expected 0.00000000002568359375. That fails the exact-at-reported-precision check, which is too tight (error 2.7e-17, while the original bound was <=1e-10). Probe graphs (numeric sort with +-1e16) are justified; recomputed probe sums are 0.0000000000 and -12.0000000000.
